from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

r=Robot()
Q=[0,1,0,0] # vertical brush (wxyz)
OUT=Path('/app/output')

def tip():
    return np.array(r.get_obs(cameras=['scene_cam']).meta['proprio']['now'][7:10],float)

def move(points, note='', save=None, cameras=['practice_cam','canvas_cam','side_cam'], video='none'):
    a=np.array([list(p)+Q for p in points],np.float32)
    result=r.submit('ee_pose',a,dt=.05,cameras=cameras,video=video,note=note)
    print(note,'rows',len(points),'steps',result.meta.get('control_steps_chunk'),'failed',sum(x['ik_failures'] for x in result.meta.get('plan',[])),'tip',result.group('tcp_pose',now=True)[:3],flush=True)
    if save: result.save(str(OUT/save))
    return result

def line(a,b,n):
    return [tuple(x) for x in np.linspace(a,b,n)]

def transit(target, n=30, hold=10, note='transit',save=None):
    p=tip(); return move(line(p,target,n)+[target]*hold,note,save)

def dip():
    p=tip(); high=(-.1,.15,.075); low=(-.1,.15,.021)
    move(line(p,high,40)+[high]*10,note='approach ink stone')
    move(line(high,low,15)+[low]*15,note='dip ink stone',save='dip')
    move(line(low,high,15)+[high]*10,note='lift from ink stone')

if __name__=='__main__':
    dip()
